concept_base_prompt: Cannonback, the shell-sentinel water turtle creature for a stylised 3D creature-collecting action RPG, the SAME character as the reference board images, unchanged identity, same clean painted style as the reference 3D render. A massive heavy fortress turtle on four thick sturdy pillar legs with big cream-ivory claws. FACE: a CREAM BEAKED FACE: a broad hooked snapping-turtle beak of smooth cream-ivory horn (#eadfc4); lower face, jaw, chin and throat pale cream; upper head and brow covered in ocean-blue scales; warm amber-gold eye under a heavy blue scaled brow; calm steady expression. SHELL: NOT a smooth tortoise dome. The shell is a rugged FORTRESS OF STACKED ROCKY STONE SLABS exactly like the board: many thick chunky irregular slate-blue and blue-grey stone plates (#52729a, #6f7f90) piled and overlapping in layers like a dry-stone wall, each slab a separate thick rock with chipped bevelled edges and visible depth steps between layers, an uneven blocky rocky silhouette, thick clumps of olive-green moss (#6f7436) growing between and on top of the slabs. CANNONS: medium-sized barrel cannons of weathered bronze-tan stone (#b8a070) with a rounded rim and a dark round bore, each barrel clearly smaller than the head, SEATED DEEP INTO the shell: the lower half of every barrel is sunk between the stone slabs and wrapped by surrounding rock plates and moss, only the upper barrel and muzzle protrude, never perched on top of the shell. SADDLE SEAT: the centre of the back is a lower, flatter, level seat hollow of broad smooth stone slabs between the cannons, wide enough for a rider to sit between the cannons, with no cannon on the middle of the back. UNDERSIDE: a large smooth CREAM-IVORY belly plastron (#eadfc4) made of big pale cream plates, clearly visible below the shell rim from the front and side, the underside is cream, not dark, not olive, not brown. SKIN: legs, neck, head and short tail covered in large clean deep ocean-blue scales (#2e5886) over cream skin. Stylised hand-painted creature-game look with clean large readable colour blocks, Palworld / Pokemon Legends style 3D render, not photoreal, no speckle, no noise. Neutral four-legged standing stance, all four legs clearly separated with visible gaps, head facing forward and level, short tail, full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no water, no splash, no scenery, no text. Absolutely no red, pink, coral, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Single creature only, no rider, no saddle object, no straps.
